preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(0 <= p[i] <= i for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The list p must have n-1 elements, and each element must be a valid vertex index.

preconditions.expression: len(x) == n and all(x[i] in {0, 1} for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The list x must have n elements, and each element must be either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be a single integer representing the number of ways to split the tree, modulo 1000000007.
